typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	EmailRecipientsHV as string (),
	EmailRecipientsNoCI3Data as string (),
	EmailRecipientsPFK as string (),
	ENDDATE as string (),
	ExportFolder as string (),
	HCADATAFLAG as string (),
	HealthVineExportFile as string (),
	HealthVineExportFileName as string (),
	HealthVineFlag as integer (),
	HVRow_Count as integer (),
	OverrideCheckFlag as integer (),
	PFKExportFile as string (),
	PFKExportFileName as string (),
	PFKFlag as integer (),
	PFKRow_Count as integer (),
	RUNDATE as string (),
	STARTDATE as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Risk Stratification Level End Date} as string,
		{Risk Stratification Level} as integer,
		{Subscriber ID} as string,
		{Risk Stratification Level Assignment Date} as string,
		{Medicaid ID} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT       [Subscriber ID]  	,[Medicaid ID]  	,[Risk Stratification Level Assignment Date]  	,[Risk Stratification Level End Date]  	,[Risk Stratification Level]   FROM EXTRACT.CI3_RISKSTRAT_FINAL WHERE VendorName = \'HealthVine\'  ORDER BY [Subscriber ID]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> HVHeaderTable
HVHeaderTable sink(input(
		Risk_Stratification_Level_End_Date as string,
		Risk_Stratification_Level as integer,
		Subscriber_ID as string,
		Risk_Stratification_Level_Assignment_Date as string,
		Medicaid_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Risk_Stratification_Level_End_Date = {Risk Stratification Level End Date},
		Risk_Stratification_Level = {Risk Stratification Level},
		Subscriber_ID = {Subscriber ID},
		Risk_Stratification_Level_Assignment_Date = {Risk Stratification Level Assignment Date},
		Medicaid_ID = {Medicaid ID})) ~> HVFlatFileDestination
